30:     return metrics.f1_score(y_true, y_pred, average='macro')

32:     return metrics.label_ranking_average_precision_score(y_true, y_pred)
33: def hamming_loss(y_true, y_pred):
34:     return metrics.hamming_loss(y_true, y_pred)
35: def coverage_error(y_true, y_pred):

38:     return metrics.label_ranking_loss(y_true, y_pred)
